line: A little probe whose eye is a zoom lens fires a dotted sight line at each next stop and takes us from the Milky Way down to a virus.
line_cn: 眼睛就是变焦镜头的小探测器，一站站打出点线，带我们从银河一路缩到病毒。

camera.move: Log-space dolly through a shape (ring, lens, iris)
camera.expresses: going down a level of scale
camera.serves: every change of scale; a chapter turn

camera.move: Pull back from an extreme close-up
camera.serves: a cold open; a "this is the real size" moment
a measurement; a label being read

camera.move: Tracking with a moving thing while pulling out
camera.serves: light crossing space; a journey with a clock

camera.expresses: a detail too small for the scale
camera.serves: an orbit's height; a cell's part

camera.move: Shape match (a small dot becomes the next subject)
camera.expresses: the same thing at two scales
camera.serves: a planet dot to a planet; a cell icon to a cell

transitions: Transitions are made from the medium (rings, lenses, concentric layers, a covering cloud bank);
no crossfades, no hard cuts inside a zoom.
labels: Roles: a geometric sans (e.g. Jost, OFL): titles 96–132 px weight 700 with tight tracking; labels 26–34 px weight 600; small caps tags 16–18 px weight 600 with letter-spacing 3 in mist or sun. One short Chinese line where needed in a CJK sans (e.g. Noto Sans SC Bold, subset), ≥ 34 px.
Two ways in: big words rise from below their own baseline through a clip (spring, small overshoot); labels wipe left to right. Exits run the same moves backwards. No fades.
Labels: a small-caps tag above, one cream line below, attached by a 2.5 px leader. One label or one big number per screen; comparisons go in the voice, the screen gives a name and a number.

Subtitles sit bottom left: one Chinese line (36 px, cream) over one English line (26 px, mist), a 5 px sun bar at the left, rising in over 0.16 s. On a light ground they sit on an opaque night plate. Never wrapped; a long sentence becomes two cues. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
motion: 24 fps, every frame on ones; the camera and the guide move smoothly every frame.

Performance: anticipation, action, overshoot and settle on every meaningful move (squash before a jump, stretch on release, panels flapping like ears, the antenna bead lagging half a beat). Poses blend by easing, never by switching in an if.

The eye carries the face: a lid for blinks, the iris itself bending into an upward arch for a smile (never a colour block over the lens), the iris widening for surprise, the barrel stepping out with turning grooves for a zoom.
Dots of a sight line pop out one by one (0 → 1.3 → 1), then stream slowly toward the target, growing in at the start and shrinking out at the end.

native_moves.name: The sight line
native_moves.does: The guide's lens fires a dotted line at the next stop; the line can become what the level needs: light walking at constant speed, a tape measure, a trail, a stream into the scale ribbon.
native_moves.fits: the distance from a city to its water source; a nerve signal; the route of a migrating bird.

native_moves.name: Through the ring
native_moves.does: The next-stop ring grows to fill the frame while the outside level blows past; the next level grows inside the ring from a point.
native_moves.fits: a country to a city; a city to a building; an organ to a tissue.

native_moves.name: True size, at last
native_moves.does: The guide, always drawn at "guide size", is shown once at true scale next to an everyday object, then the narration says it now shrinks with us.
native_moves.fits: a microchip; an ant; a snowflake.

native_moves.name: The scale ribbon summary
native_moves.does: The corner ribbon moves to centre stage, the dots run along it lighting each stop, and the progress fills.
native_moves.fits: the ages of the Earth; the sizes of particles; a history of computing power.

native_moves.name: Inside the lens
native_moves.does: The camera dives into the guide's own lens and the next world is inside the glass.
native_moves.fits: a look into a cell; a peek inside an atom; switching from a map to street level.

score.note: tuned percussion and plucks; timpani and triangle for locks
